axes.name: Craft
axes.note: Renamed from the default lens's Stewardship, same position, same role. Rename an axis when the default word does not cut your world at its joint; keep the role if the counts should still treat it the same way.
axes.what: whether a person makes real things and maintains them — in this owner's world, the commons is tended by makers, so stewardship is read as craft.

axes.what: the effect a person's contact has on other people — in this owner's terms, whether people leave the encounter with more than they brought.

comment: A lens file redefines the wavefront's metric. Every field is optional and merges over the default lens (Will Bickford's nine) field by field, position by position (axes are listed in coordinate order, 1-9). Delete any field you do not want to change. Fields per axis: name, what (one-line definition), anchors (exactly 5 scale lines, low to high), note, role, default. Roles mark what the archive counts may evidence: the 'reciprocity' role receives the reply-share band (share >= 0.7 -> 4, 0.4-0.7 -> 3, < 0.4 -> 2); the 'horizon' role receives the contact-span band (span >= 365 days -> 3, else 2). The region gate reads the 'consent', 'trust', 'reciprocity' and 'fidelity' roles; a lens that does not mark all four carries no region verdicts. 'default' is the value an archive-detected entry takes on that axis (1-5). This example renames two axes, re-anchors one, moves nothing, and changes one default — a small edit, on purpose: most owners will only rename what does not fit.
